quantum-vendor · computing-hardware · College Park, MD, United States · ionq.com

Machines in the Atlas (7)

  • Aria — DEPLOYED, 32 q, 2022
  • Forte / Forte Enterprise — DEPLOYED, 30 q, available since 2022 (Enterprise 2024-25)
  • QUARTET — DEPLOYED, 32 q, 13 Aug 2025 (NQCC Harwell)
  • Tempo — DEPLOYED, 100 q, 2025-2026
  • 40-ion Ba-133 qLDPC testbed — DEMONSTRATED, 40 q, Jun 2026
  • Superion 256 — ANNOUNCED (orderable; first ions trapped in prototypes; deliveries 2027 — NVAQC 2027, FIU late 2027), 256 q, 8 Sep 2026
  • IonQ Superion 10K — PLANNED (full fault tolerance in a 2027 lab setting; commercial 2028), 10,000 q, Sep 2026
